about: Executive orders the president may issue that an engine carries (pool item office-presidential-orders-pardons-the-situation-room). Each is a federal law row, in force the next day, that the named engine reads; the character issues it only from the president's own view on the question, and a later president revokes it the same way.

federal-pay-floor.question: us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.raise-minimum-wage
federal-pay-floor.citation: Executive Order 14026 (April 27, 2021) set $15 an hour for federal contractors; the same rate for the federal government's own employees is an estimate, a full-time year at 2,080 hours (5 U.S.C. 6101).
federal-pay-floor.spread: Biden's order phased the contractor rate to $15 by January 30, 2022; a president may pick any hourly figure, so the player-facing amount is a tunable between the federal minimum wage ($7.25) and $17.
